name: @red-cup-engineering/relation-model-notation-cbor-codec
description: Generic RFC 8949 canonical (core deterministic) CBOR codec and RFC 6920 ni:// content-addressing: encodeCanonical/decodeCanonical, canonicalEqual, sha256Bytes/niUri/sha256Hex, rawSha256Bytes/rawNiUri, and the normalizeCarrier/semanticBytes/semanticId/decodeSemantic semantic layer. Generic over any JSON-shaped value (booleans, null, safe-integer numbers, bigints, strings, Buffer/Uint8Array, arrays, plain objects) — no dependency on any particular term grammar's shape, including the RMN grammar itself.
